base-loss.title: Dead spin
base-loss.note: No line, no kilo, no pay.

hook-fail.title: Hook miss
hook-fail.note: Two kilos locked. The respin did not find a third.

line-win.title: Line win
line-win.note: Base lines only. Fish cash is not collected.

hook-upgrade.title: Hook upgrade
hook-upgrade.note: Two kilos locked, and the respin opened the feature.

tool-hook.title: Hook tool
tool-hook.note: Bass were in, Splash was not. One reel shifted.

multi-collect.title: Several collectors
multi-collect.note: More than one Splash collected the same bass pool.

meter-4.title: Meter ×2
meter-4.note: The catch crossed 4. Extra spins use the new meter next spin.

natural.title: Natural feature
natural.note: Three or more kilos on the paid board.

meter-10.title: Meter ×10
meter-10.note: The catch crossed 12. No further retrigger.

tool-dynamite.title: Dynamite
tool-dynamite.note: Splash was in, bass were not. Dynamite planted bass.

tool-bazooka.title: Bazooka
tool-bazooka.note: Splash was in, bass were not. The other cells refilled.

capped-ante.title: Cap on ante
capped-ante.note: The round hit the win cap.

buy.title: Buy
buy.note: Paid entry. No base line or scatter pay.

capped-buy.title: Cap on a buy
capped-buy.note: The round hit the win cap. High stakes hit this more often.

chopper.title: Chopper
chopper.note: Paid entry. Starts further up the meter. More bass in the feature.

capped-chopper.title: Cap on chopper
capped-chopper.note: The round hit the win cap.

small-line.title: Small line
small-line.note: Line win of 200 on a 1,000 charge. Below the charge, so it is not a profit.
